players.product: GPU cloud / AI compute capacity (NVIDIA GB300 NVL72)

quarterly_data.signal: ChronoScale's 10-Q (quarter ended August 31, 2026): revenue $41,482 thousand, up 148% from $16,718 thousand; net loss from continuing operations $26,430 thousand; adjusted EBITDA $6,018 thousand. The Cloud Business was about 94.1% of revenue: 6,144 NVIDIA H100 GPUs deployed across Colorado, Minnesota and Utah with one GPU capacity customer, plus one-time AI hardware resale arrangements with one additional customer; Customer A was 56% and Customer B 44% of revenue. The Legacy Ekso business was sold after the quarter.
quarterly_data.figure: revenue $41,482 thousand (+148%); adjusted EBITDA $6,018 thousand; 6,144 H100 GPUs; Customer A 56%, Customer B 44%

quarterly_data.signal: ChronoScale's 10-Q contracted pipeline: during the quarter it signed GPU services agreements with two customers, each with a three-year committed term, for aggregate contracted revenues of $2.7 billion, and is contractually committed to project-specific capital expenditures of approximately $2.3 billion over the next twelve months; purchase obligations for AI infrastructure were $2.0 billion at August 31, 2026, and it received $328.2 million of prepayments under existing customer contracts after the quarter. Deployments depend in part on obtaining financing.
quarterly_data.figure: $2.7 billion contracted revenues (two three-year agreements); approximately $2.3 billion committed capex; $2.0 billion purchase obligations; $328.2 million prepayments

quarterly_data.signal: ChronoScale's 10-Q: on October 11, 2026 ChronoScale signed a term sheet with Applied Digital (related party) to provide a $50.0 million upfront advance for tenant fit-out costs at a third-party data center facility in Texas, where it expects to lease space from a joint venture being formed between Applied Digital and a third party with site control; the lease, still under negotiation, is expected to provide the compute capacity needed for the Microsoft deployment.
quarterly_data.counterparty_role: expected data center lessor (via a joint venture)

connects_to.relationship: 50-MW AI compute deployment on NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 systems

contracts.signal: ChronoScale's 10-Q: the Microsoft GPU Services Agreement (signed August 6, 2026, amended effective August 21, 2026) provides dedicated GPU services at a data center facility in Texas over an approximately three-year term supporting approximately 50 MW, in two tranches of NVIDIA GB300 GPUs expected in February and March of 2027 with roughly equal GPU quantity and contract value; neither party may terminate for convenience, and upfront payments are refundable on certain terminations.
